searchText: Hi there, I am running geth-lighthouse PeerDAS node (1 lh super node and 1 ordinal node). One day ago the epochs stopped finilazing. Looks like `validator-key-generation-cl-validator-keystore` service stopped. I see that ELs have a handshake issue. Is it critical? Can I somehow start this service? Here is my yaml file: ``` participants: # Supernodes - cl_type: lighthouse cl_extra_params: [--subscribe-all-data-column-subnets] cl_image: ethpandaops/lighthouse:das-devnet-2 # Non supernodes - cl_type: lighthouse cl_image: ethpandaops/lighthouse:das-devnet-2 network_params: eip7594_fork_epoch: 0 eip7594_fork_version: "0x50000038" snooper_enabled: true global_log_level: debug additional_services: - dora - goomy_blob - prometheus_grafana ``` I think the `validator-key-generation-cl-validator-keystore` being in STOPPED status is normal after successful startup looks like one of the lighthouse node is down? you've got 50% participation there. Unfortunately there's currently a stack overflow issue in Lighthouse (https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/issues/6105) and is still being worked on. In the mean time *I think* you could workaround it by increasing the stack size for all lighthouse nodes, so it doesn't crash (it's not ideal, hopefully we fix this soon) ``` participants: # Supernodes - cl_type: lighthouse cl_extra_params: [--subscribe-all-data-column-subnets] cl_image: ethpandaops/lighthouse:das-devnet-2 cl_extra_env_vars: RUST_MIN_STACK: '4194304' ... ```

excerpts.content:
Hi there, I am running geth-lighthouse PeerDAS node (1 lh super node and 1 ordinal node). One day ago the epochs stopped finilazing. Looks like `validator-key-generation-cl-validator-keystore` service stopped. I see that ELs have a handshake issue. Is it critical? Can I somehow start this service? Here is my yaml file:
```
participants:
  # Supernodes
  - cl_type: lighthouse
    cl_extra_params: [--subscribe-all-data-column-subnets]
    cl_image: ethpandaops/lighthouse:das-devnet-2
  # Non supernodes
  - cl_type: lighthouse
    cl_image: ethpandaops/lighthouse:das-devnet-2
network_params:
  eip7594_fork_epoch: 0
  eip7594_fork_version: "0x50000038"
snooper_enabled: true
global_log_level: debug
additional_services:
  - dora
  - goomy_blob
  - prometheus_grafana
```

excerpts.author: jimmygchen
excerpts.content:
I think the `validator-key-generation-cl-validator-keystore` being in STOPPED status is normal after successful startup
looks like one of the lighthouse node is down? you've got 50% participation there.
Unfortunately there's currently a stack overflow issue in Lighthouse (https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/issues/6105) and is still being worked on.

In the mean time *I think* you could workaround it by increasing the stack size for all lighthouse nodes, so it doesn't crash (it's not ideal, hopefully we fix this soon)
```
participants:
  # Supernodes
  - cl_type: lighthouse
    cl_extra_params: [--subscribe-all-data-column-subnets]
    cl_image: ethpandaops/lighthouse:das-devnet-2
    cl_extra_env_vars:
      RUST_MIN_STACK: '4194304'
...
```
